comment: Captions for every announced event. Subtitles are on by default and can be resized or hidden in the accessibility settings.

subtitles.speaker: KOM CONTROL
subtitles.text: Kiln Site 12 is running a night shift. You are not taking the plant, you are stopping it.

subtitles.speaker: KOM CONTROL
subtitles.text: Breach the yard gate, charge the fuel line, pull the relay logs, hold the hall while the charges arm, then extract from the north pad.

subtitles.speaker: KOM CONTROL
subtitles.text: Two operator minimum. If somebody goes down, pick them up - they bleed out in under a minute.

subtitles.speaker: KOM CONTROL
subtitles.text: Move to the rail spur south of the yard. Stay off the floodlit apron.

subtitles.speaker: KOM CONTROL
subtitles.text: Cut the gate chain. It will be heard inside the plant.

subtitles.speaker: OPERATOR
subtitles.text: Gate is open. Moving in.

subtitles.speaker: KOM CONTROL
subtitles.text: Two charges on the fuel line. Split up only if you have to.

subtitles.speaker: OPERATOR
subtitles.text: First charge set and armed.

subtitles.speaker: KOM CONTROL
subtitles.text: Control room terminal. Take the logs, leave the hardware.

subtitles.speaker: OPERATOR
subtitles.text: Logs are on the drive. I have it.

subtitles.speaker: KOM CONTROL
subtitles.text: Charges are arming. Hold the kiln hall for forty five seconds.

subtitles.speaker: MILITIA RADIO
subtitles.text: Intruders inside the plant! Everybody to the kiln hall, now!

subtitles.speaker: KOM CONTROL
subtitles.text: Extraction is inbound to the north pad. You have just over a minute before it lands.

subtitles.speaker: AIRCREW
subtitles.text: We are on the pad and we are not staying. Get aboard.

subtitles.speaker: OPERATOR
subtitles.text: I am down! I need a hand here!

subtitles.speaker: OPERATOR
subtitles.text: Contact, kiln hall side!

subtitles.speaker: MATCH CONTROL
subtitles.text: Kits locked. Twenty operators, no teams. First to fifty eliminations takes the match.

subtitles.speaker: MATCH CONTROL
subtitles.text: Match over. Results are on the board.

subtitles.speaker: RADIO
subtitles.text: Radio message: moving up.

subtitles.speaker: RADIO
subtitles.text: Radio message: hold position.

subtitles.speaker: RADIO
subtitles.text: Radio message: contact at my marker.

subtitles.speaker: RADIO
subtitles.text: Radio message: reloading, cover me.

subtitles.speaker: RADIO
subtitles.text: Radio message: I am down, I need a revive.
